fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the index is case-sensitive.

true: The index is case-sensitive.

false (default): The index is not case-sensitive
fields.help_zh: 是否大小写敏感。默认值为 false
fields.name: case_sensitive

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether the logs contain Chinese characters.

true: The logs contain Chinese characters.

false (default): The logs do not contain Chinese characters
fields.help_zh: 是否包含中文。默认值为 false，开启包含中文后，写入能力可能会有一定下降
fields.name: chn

fields.help_en: The list of fields to exclude from the full-text index. This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as \`include\_keys\`
fields.help_zh: 排除的字段列表，不能与include_keys同时指定
fields.name: exclude_keys

fields.help_en: The list of fields to include in the full-text index. This parameter cannot be specified at the same time as \`exclude\_keys\`
fields.help_zh: 包含的字段列表，不能与exclude_keys同时指定
fields.name: include_keys

fields.help_en: The list of delimiters for tokenization. This parameter specifies how the field is tokenized
fields.help_zh: 分词符列表。可以设置一个分词参数，指定这个字段按照哪一种方式分词
fields.name: token

parameters.help_en: The full-text index configuration. You must specify either this parameter or the \`keys\` parameter
parameters.name: line

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable log clustering. If enabled, either the whitelist or the blacklist can be active, but not both.

true: Enable log clustering.

false (default): Do not enable log clustering
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启日志聚类。开启后白名单与黑名单至多生效其中一个。

true：开启日志聚类。
false（默认值）：不开启日志聚类
parameters.name: log_reduce

parameters.help_en: The blacklist of fields for log clustering. This parameter is valid only when log clustering is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤黑名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效
parameters.name: log_reduce_black_list

parameters.help_en: The whitelist of fields for log clustering. This parameter is valid only when log clustering is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤白名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效
parameters.name: log_reduce_white_list

parameters.help_en: The default maximum length of a field value in Simple Log Service is 2,048 bytes (2 KB). To change this limit, set the maximum length for a text field. The value must be between 64 and 16,384 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务默认字段值的最大长度为2048字节，即2 KB。如果您需要修改字段值的最大长度，可设置统计字段（text）最大长度，取值范围为64~16384字节
parameters.name: max_text_len

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the scan index
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启扫描索引。全文索引、字段索引、扫描索引至少需要存在一个
parameters.name: scan_index
